16 # Segments in vector spaces
17 
18 In a 𝕜-vector space, we define the following objects and properties.
19 * `segment 𝕜 x y`: Closed segment joining `x` and `y`.
20 * `openSegment 𝕜 x y`: Open segment joining `x` and `y`.
21 
22 ## Notation
23 
24 We provide the following notation:
25 * `[x -[𝕜] y] = segment 𝕜 x y` in scope `Convex`
26 
27 ## TODO
28

30 
31 Should we rename `segment` and `openSegment` to `convex.Icc` and `convex.Ioo`? Should we also
32 define `clopenSegment`/`convex.Ico`/`convex.Ioc`?
33 -/

48 variable (𝕜) [SMul 𝕜 E] {s : Set E} {x y : E}

50 /-- Segments in a vector space. Denoted as `[x -[𝕜] y]` within the `Convex` namespace. -/
51 def segment (x y : E) : Set E :=
52   { z : E | ∃ a b : 𝕜, 0 ≤ a ∧ 0 ≤ b ∧ a + b = 1 ∧ a • x + b • y = z }
53 
54 /-- Open segment in a vector space. Note that `openSegment 𝕜 x x = {x}` instead of being `∅` when
55 the base semiring has some element between `0` and `1`. -/
56 def openSegment (x y : E) : Set E :=
57   { z : E | ∃ a b : 𝕜, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ a + b = 1 ∧ a • x + b • y = z }
58 
59 @[inherit_doc] scoped[Convex] notation (priority := high) "[" x " -[" 𝕜 "] " y "]" => segment 𝕜 x y
60 
61 theorem segment_eq_image₂ (x y : E) :
62     [x -[𝕜] y] =
63       (fun p : 𝕜 × 𝕜 => p.1 • x + p.2 • y) '' { p | 0 ≤ p.1 ∧ 0 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.1 + p.2 = 1 } := by
64   simp only [segment, image, Prod.exists, mem_setOf_eq, and_assoc]
65 
66 theorem openSegment_eq_image₂ (x y : E) :
67     openSegment 𝕜 x y =
68       (fun p : 𝕜 × 𝕜 => p.1 • x + p.2 • y) '' { p | 0 < p.1 ∧ 0 < p.2 ∧ p.1 + p.2 = 1 } := by
69   simp only [openSegment, image, Prod.exists, mem_setOf_eq, and_assoc]
70 
71 theorem segment_symm (x y : E) : [x -[𝕜] y] = [y -[𝕜] x] :=
72   Set.ext fun _ =>
73     ⟨fun ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, H⟩ => ⟨b, a, hb, ha, (add_comm _ _).trans hab, (add_comm _ _).trans H⟩,
74       fun ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, H⟩ =>
75       ⟨b, a, hb, ha, (add_comm _ _).trans hab, (add_comm _ _).trans H⟩⟩
76 
77 theorem openSegment_symm (x y : E) : openSegment 𝕜 x y = openSegment 𝕜 y x :=
78   Set.ext fun _ =>
79     ⟨fun ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, H⟩ => ⟨b, a, hb, ha, (add_comm _ _).trans hab, (add_comm _ _).trans H⟩,
80       fun ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, H⟩ =>
81       ⟨b, a, hb, ha, (add_comm _ _).trans hab, (add_comm _ _).trans H⟩⟩
82 
83 theorem openSegment_subset_segment (x y : E) : openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ [x -[𝕜] y] :=
84   fun _ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩ => ⟨a, b, ha.le, hb.le, hab, hz⟩
85 
86 theorem segment_subset_iff :
87     [x -[𝕜] y] ⊆ s ↔ ∀ a b : 𝕜, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a + b = 1 → a • x + b • y ∈ s :=
88   ⟨fun H a b ha hb hab => H ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩, fun H _ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩ =>
89     hz ▸ H a b ha hb hab⟩
90 
91 theorem openSegment_subset_iff :
92     openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ s ↔ ∀ a b : 𝕜, 0 < a → 0 < b → a + b = 1 → a • x + b • y ∈ s :=
93   ⟨fun H a b ha hb hab => H ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩, fun H _ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩ =>
94     hz ▸ H a b ha hb hab⟩
95

105 theorem left_mem_segment (x y : E) : x ∈ [x -[𝕜] y] :=
106   ⟨1, 0, zero_le_one, le_refl 0, add_zero 1, by rw [zero_smul, one_smul, add_zero]⟩
107 
108 theorem right_mem_segment (x y : E) : y ∈ [x -[𝕜] y] :=
109   segment_symm 𝕜 y x ▸ left_mem_segment 𝕜 y x

118 @[simp]
119 theorem segment_same (x : E) : [x -[𝕜] x] = {x} :=
120   Set.ext fun z =>
121     ⟨fun ⟨a, b, _, _, hab, hz⟩ => by
122       simpa only [(add_smul _ _ _).symm, mem_singleton_iff, hab, one_smul, eq_comm] using hz,
123       fun h => mem_singleton_iff.1 h ▸ left_mem_segment 𝕜 z z⟩
124 
125 theorem insert_endpoints_openSegment (x y : E) :
126     insert x (insert y (openSegment 𝕜 x y)) = [x -[𝕜] y] := by
127   simp only [subset_antisymm_iff, insert_subset_iff, left_mem_segment, right_mem_segment,
128     openSegment_subset_segment, true_and]
129   rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
130   refine hb.eq_or_lt.imp ?_ fun hb' => ha.eq_or_lt.imp ?_ fun ha' => ?_
131   · rintro rfl
132     rw [← add_zero a, hab, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero]
133   · rintro rfl
134     rw [← zero_add b, hab, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add]
135   · exact ⟨a, b, ha', hb', hab, rfl⟩
136 
137 variable {𝕜}
138 
139 theorem mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right (hx : x ≠ z) (hy : y ≠ z) (hz : z ∈ [x -[𝕜] y]) :
140     z ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x y := by
141   rw [← insert_endpoints_openSegment] at hz
142   exact (hz.resolve_left hx.symm).resolve_left hy.symm
143 
144 theorem openSegment_subset_iff_segment_subset (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s) :
145     openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ s ↔ [x -[𝕜] y] ⊆ s := by
146   simp only [← insert_endpoints_openSegment, insert_subset_iff, *, true_and]

153 theorem segment.lift [SMulPosMono R 𝕜] (x y : E) : segment R x y ⊆ segment 𝕜 x y := by
154   rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hxy⟩
155   refine ⟨_, _, ?_, ?_, by simpa [add_smul] using congr($(hab) • (1 : 𝕜)), by simpa⟩
156   all_goals exact zero_smul R (1 : 𝕜) ▸ smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right ‹_› zero_le_one
157 
158 theorem openSegment.lift [Nontrivial 𝕜] [SMulPosStrictMono R 𝕜] (x y : E) :
159     openSegment R x y ⊆ openSegment 𝕜 x y := by
160   rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hxy⟩
161   refine ⟨_, _, ?_, ?_, by simpa [add_smul] using congr($(hab) • (1 : 𝕜)), by simpa⟩
162   all_goals exact zero_smul R (1 : 𝕜) ▸ smul_lt_smul_of_pos_right ‹_› zero_lt_one
163 
164 end lift

181 @[simp]
182 theorem openSegment_same (x : E) : openSegment 𝕜 x x = {x} :=
183   Set.ext fun z =>
184     ⟨fun ⟨a, b, _, _, hab, hz⟩ => by
185       simpa only [← add_smul, mem_singleton_iff, hab, one_smul, eq_comm] using hz,
186     fun h : z = x => by
187       obtain ⟨a, ha₀, ha₁⟩ := DenselyOrdered.dense (0 : 𝕜) 1 zero_lt_one
188       refine ⟨a, 1 - a, ha₀, sub_pos_of_lt ha₁, add_sub_cancel _ _, ?_⟩
189       rw [← add_smul, add_sub_cancel, one_smul, h]⟩
190 
191 end DenselyOrdered

193 theorem segment_eq_image (x y : E) :
194     [x -[𝕜] y] = (fun θ : 𝕜 => (1 - θ) • x + θ • y) '' Icc (0 : 𝕜) 1 :=
195   Set.ext fun _ =>
196     ⟨fun ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩ =>
197       ⟨b, ⟨hb, hab ▸ le_add_of_nonneg_left ha⟩, hab ▸ hz ▸ by simp only [add_sub_cancel_right]⟩,
198       fun ⟨θ, ⟨hθ₀, hθ₁⟩, hz⟩ => ⟨1 - θ, θ, sub_nonneg.2 hθ₁, hθ₀, sub_add_cancel _ _, hz⟩⟩
199 
200 theorem openSegment_eq_image (x y : E) :
201     openSegment 𝕜 x y = (fun θ : 𝕜 => (1 - θ) • x + θ • y) '' Ioo (0 : 𝕜) 1 :=
202   Set.ext fun _ =>
203     ⟨fun ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩ =>
204       ⟨b, ⟨hb, hab ▸ lt_add_of_pos_left _ ha⟩, hab ▸ hz ▸ by simp only [add_sub_cancel_right]⟩,
205       fun ⟨θ, ⟨hθ₀, hθ₁⟩, hz⟩ => ⟨1 - θ, θ, sub_pos.2 hθ₁, hθ₀, sub_add_cancel _ _, hz⟩⟩
206 
207 theorem segment_eq_image' (x y : E) :
208     [x -[𝕜] y] = (fun θ : 𝕜 => x + θ • (y - x)) '' Icc (0 : 𝕜) 1 := by
209   convert segment_eq_image 𝕜 x y using 2
210   simp only [smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
211   abel
212 
213 theorem openSegment_eq_image' (x y : E) :
214     openSegment 𝕜 x y = (fun θ : 𝕜 => x + θ • (y - x)) '' Ioo (0 : 𝕜) 1 := by
215   convert openSegment_eq_image 𝕜 x y using 2
216   simp only [smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
217   abel
218 
219 theorem segment_eq_image_lineMap (x y : E) : [x -[𝕜] y] =
220     AffineMap.lineMap x y '' Icc (0 : 𝕜) 1 := by
221   convert segment_eq_image 𝕜 x y using 2
222   exact AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module _ _ _
223 
224 theorem openSegment_eq_image_lineMap (x y : E) :
225     openSegment 𝕜 x y = AffineMap.lineMap x y '' Ioo (0 : 𝕜) 1 := by
226   convert openSegment_eq_image 𝕜 x y using 2
227   exact AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module _ _ _
228 
229 theorem lineMap_mem_openSegment (a b : E) {t : 𝕜} (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 1) :
230     AffineMap.lineMap a b t ∈ openSegment 𝕜 a b :=
231   openSegment_eq_image_lineMap 𝕜 a b ▸ mem_image_of_mem _ ht

233 @[simp]
234 theorem image_segment (f : E →ᵃ[𝕜] F) (a b : E) : f '' [a -[𝕜] b] = [f a -[𝕜] f b] :=
235   Set.ext fun x => by
236     simp_rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap, mem_image, exists_exists_and_eq_and, AffineMap.apply_lineMap]

238 @[simp]
239 theorem image_openSegment (f : E →ᵃ[𝕜] F) (a b : E) :
240     f '' openSegment 𝕜 a b = openSegment 𝕜 (f a) (f b) :=
241   Set.ext fun x => by
242     simp_rw [openSegment_eq_image_lineMap, mem_image, exists_exists_and_eq_and,
243       AffineMap.apply_lineMap]

246 theorem vadd_segment [AddTorsor G E] [VAddCommClass G E E] (a : G) (b c : E) :
247     a +ᵥ [b -[𝕜] c] = [a +ᵥ b -[𝕜] a +ᵥ c] :=

262 theorem mem_segment_translate (a : E) {x b c} : a + x ∈ [a + b -[𝕜] a + c] ↔ x ∈ [b -[𝕜] c] := by
263   simp_rw [← vadd_eq_add, ← vadd_segment, vadd_mem_vadd_set_iff]

267     a + x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 (a + b) (a + c) ↔ x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 b c := by
268   simp_rw [← vadd_eq_add, ← vadd_openSegment, vadd_mem_vadd_set_iff]

270 theorem segment_translate_preimage (a b c : E) :
271     (fun x => a + x) ⁻¹' [a + b -[𝕜] a + c] = [b -[𝕜] c] :=
272   Set.ext fun _ => mem_segment_translate 𝕜 a
273 
274 theorem openSegment_translate_preimage (a b c : E) :
275     (fun x => a + x) ⁻¹' openSegment 𝕜 (a + b) (a + c) = openSegment 𝕜 b c :=
276   Set.ext fun _ => mem_openSegment_translate 𝕜 a
277 
278 theorem segment_translate_image (a b c : E) : (fun x => a + x) '' [b -[𝕜] c] = [a + b -[𝕜] a + c] :=
279   segment_translate_preimage 𝕜 a b c ▸ image_preimage_eq _ <| add_left_surjective a

281 theorem openSegment_translate_image (a b c : E) :
282     (fun x => a + x) '' openSegment 𝕜 b c = openSegment 𝕜 (a + b) (a + c) :=
283   openSegment_translate_preimage 𝕜 a b c ▸ image_preimage_eq _ <| add_left_surjective a

285 lemma segment_inter_subset_endpoint_of_linearIndependent_sub
286     {c x y : E} (h : LinearIndependent 𝕜 ![x - c, y - c]) :
287     [c -[𝕜] x] ∩ [c -[𝕜] y] ⊆ {c} := by
288   intro z ⟨hzt, hzs⟩
289   rw [segment_eq_image, mem_image] at hzt hzs
290   rcases hzt with ⟨p, ⟨p0, p1⟩, rfl⟩
291   rcases hzs with ⟨q, ⟨q0, q1⟩, H⟩
292   have Hx : x = (x - c) + c := by abel
293   have Hy : y = (y - c) + c := by abel
294   rw [Hx, Hy, smul_add, smul_add] at H
295   have : c + q • (y - c) = c + p • (x - c) := by
296     convert H using 1 <;> simp [sub_smul]
297   obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ : p = 0 ∧ q = 0 := h.eq_zero_of_pair' ((add_right_inj c).1 this).symm
298   simp
299 
300 lemma segment_inter_eq_endpoint_of_linearIndependent_sub [ZeroLEOneClass 𝕜]
301     {c x y : E} (h : LinearIndependent 𝕜 ![x - c, y - c]) :
302     [c -[𝕜] x] ∩ [c -[𝕜] y] = {c} := by
303   refine (segment_inter_subset_endpoint_of_linearIndependent_sub 𝕜 h).antisymm ?_
304   simp [singleton_subset_iff, left_mem_segment]
305 
306 end OrderedRing

308 theorem sameRay_of_mem_segment [CommRing 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜]
309     [AddCommGroup E] [Module 𝕜 E] {x y z : E}
310     (h : x ∈ [y -[𝕜] z]) : SameRay 𝕜 (x - y) (z - x) := by
311   rw [segment_eq_image'] at h
312   rcases h with ⟨θ, ⟨hθ₀, hθ₁⟩, rfl⟩
313   simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left, ← sub_sub, sub_smul, one_smul] using
314     (SameRay.sameRay_nonneg_smul_left (z - y) hθ₀).nonneg_smul_right (sub_nonneg.2 hθ₁)
315 
316 lemma segment_inter_eq_endpoint_of_linearIndependent_of_ne
317     [CommRing 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [IsOrderedRing 𝕜] [IsDomain 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [Module 𝕜 E]
318     {x y : E} (h : LinearIndependent 𝕜 ![x, y]) {s t : 𝕜} (hs : s ≠ t) (c : E) :
319     [c + x -[𝕜] c + t • y] ∩ [c + x -[𝕜] c + s • y] = {c + x} := by
320   apply segment_inter_eq_endpoint_of_linearIndependent_sub
321   simp only [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
322   suffices H : LinearIndependent 𝕜 ![(-1 : 𝕜) • x + t • y, (-1 : 𝕜) • x + s • y] by
323     convert H using 1; simp only [neg_smul, one_smul]; abel_nf
324   nontriviality 𝕜
325   rw [LinearIndependent.pair_add_smul_add_smul_iff]
326   aesop

332 theorem midpoint_mem_openSegment [Invertible (2 : 𝕜)] (x y : E) :
333     midpoint 𝕜 x y ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x y := by
334   rw [openSegment_eq_image_lineMap]
335   exact ⟨⅟2, ⟨invOf_pos.mpr two_pos, invOf_lt_one one_lt_two⟩, rfl⟩
336 
337 theorem midpoint_mem_segment [Invertible (2 : 𝕜)] (x y : E) : midpoint 𝕜 x y ∈ [x -[𝕜] y] :=
338   openSegment_subset_segment _ _ _ <| midpoint_mem_openSegment _ _
339 
340 theorem mem_openSegment_sub_add [Invertible (2 : 𝕜)] (x y : E) :
341     x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 (x - y) (x + y) := by
342   convert midpoint_mem_openSegment (𝕜 := 𝕜) (x - y) (x + y)
343   rw [midpoint_sub_add]
344 
345 theorem mem_segment_sub_add [Invertible (2 : 𝕜)] (x y : E) : x ∈ [x - y -[𝕜] x + y] :=
346   openSegment_subset_segment _ _ _ <| mem_openSegment_sub_add _ _
347 
348 theorem mem_openSegment_add_sub [Invertible (2 : 𝕜)] (x y : E) :
349     x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 (x + y) (x - y) := by
350   convert midpoint_mem_openSegment (𝕜 := 𝕜) (x + y) (x - y)
351   rw [midpoint_add_sub]
352 
353 theorem mem_segment_add_sub [Invertible (2 : 𝕜)] (x y : E) : x ∈ [x + y -[𝕜] x - y] :=
354   openSegment_subset_segment _ _ _ <| mem_openSegment_add_sub _ _

356 @[simp]
357 theorem left_mem_openSegment_iff [DenselyOrdered 𝕜] [IsTorsionFree 𝕜 E] :
358     x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x y ↔ x = y := by
359   constructor
360   · rintro ⟨a, b, _, hb, hab, hx⟩
361     refine smul_right_injective _ hb.ne' ((add_right_inj (a • x)).1 ?_)
362     rw [hx, ← add_smul, hab, one_smul]
363   · rintro rfl
364     rw [openSegment_same]
365     exact mem_singleton _
366 
367 @[simp]
368 theorem right_mem_openSegment_iff [DenselyOrdered 𝕜] [IsTorsionFree 𝕜 E] :
369     y ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x y ↔ x = y := by rw [openSegment_symm, left_mem_openSegment_iff, eq_comm]
370

373 section LinearOrderedSemifield
374 
375 variable [Semifield 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [Module 𝕜 E]
376   {x y z : E}
377 
378 theorem mem_segment_iff_div :
379     x ∈ [y -[𝕜] z] ↔
380       ∃ a b : 𝕜, 0 ≤ a ∧ 0 ≤ b ∧ 0 < a + b ∧ (a / (a + b)) • y + (b / (a + b)) • z = x := by
381   constructor
382   · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
383     use a, b, ha, hb
384     simp [*]
385   · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
386     refine ⟨a / (a + b), b / (a + b), by positivity, by positivity, ?_, rfl⟩
387     rw [← add_div, div_self hab.ne']
388 
389 theorem mem_openSegment_iff_div : x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 y z ↔
390     ∃ a b : 𝕜, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ (a / (a + b)) • y + (b / (a + b)) • z = x := by
391   constructor
392   · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
393     use a, b, ha, hb
394     rw [hab, div_one, div_one]
395   · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, rfl⟩
396     have hab : 0 < a + b := add_pos' ha hb
397     refine ⟨a / (a + b), b / (a + b), by positivity, by positivity, ?_, rfl⟩
398     rw [← add_div, div_self hab.ne']
399 
400 end LinearOrderedSemifield
401 
402 section LinearOrderedField
403 
404 variable [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [Module 𝕜 E] {x y z : E}
405 
406 theorem mem_segment_iff_sameRay : x ∈ [y -[𝕜] z] ↔ SameRay 𝕜 (x - y) (z - x) := by
407   refine ⟨sameRay_of_mem_segment, fun h => ?_⟩
408   rcases h.exists_eq_smul_add with ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hxy, hzx⟩
409   rw [add_comm, sub_add_sub_cancel] at hxy hzx
410   rw [← mem_segment_translate _ (-x), neg_add_cancel]
411   refine ⟨b, a, hb, ha, add_comm a b ▸ hab, ?_⟩
412   rw [← sub_eq_neg_add, ← neg_sub, hxy, ← sub_eq_neg_add, hzx, smul_neg, smul_comm, neg_add_cancel]
413 
414 open AffineMap
415 
416 /-- If `z = lineMap x y c` is a point on the line passing through `x` and `y`, then the open
417 segment `openSegment 𝕜 x y` is included in the union of the open segments `openSegment 𝕜 x z`,
418 `openSegment 𝕜 z y`, and the point `z`. Informally, `(x, y) ⊆ {z} ∪ (x, z) ∪ (z, y)`. -/
419 theorem openSegment_subset_union (x y : E) {z : E} (hz : z ∈ range (lineMap x y : 𝕜 → E)) :
420     openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ insert z (openSegment 𝕜 x z ∪ openSegment 𝕜 z y) := by
421   rcases hz with ⟨c, rfl⟩
422   simp only [openSegment_eq_image_lineMap, ← mapsTo_iff_image_subset]
423   rintro a ⟨h₀, h₁⟩
424   rcases lt_trichotomy a c with (hac | rfl | hca)
425   · right
426     left
427     have hc : 0 < c := h₀.trans hac
428     refine ⟨a / c, ⟨div_pos h₀ hc, (div_lt_one hc).2 hac⟩, ?_⟩
429     simp only [← homothety_eq_lineMap, ← homothety_mul_apply, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hc.ne']
430   · left
431     rfl
432   · right
433     right
434     have hc : 0 < 1 - c := sub_pos.2 (hca.trans h₁)
435     simp only [← lineMap_apply_one_sub y]
436     refine
437       ⟨(a - c) / (1 - c), ⟨div_pos (sub_pos.2 hca) hc, (div_lt_one hc).2 <| sub_lt_sub_right h₁ _⟩,
438         ?_⟩
439     simp only [← homothety_eq_lineMap, ← homothety_mul_apply, sub_mul, one_mul,
440       div_mul_cancel₀ _ hc.ne', sub_sub_sub_cancel_right]
441 
442 end LinearOrderedField
443 
444 /-!
445 #### Segments in an ordered space
446 
447 Relates `segment`, `openSegment` and `Set.Icc`, `Set.Ico`, `Set.Ioc`, `Set.Ioo`
448 -/
449 
450 
451 section OrderedSemiring
452 
453 variable [Semiring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜]
454 
455 section OrderedAddCommMonoid
456 
457 variable [AddCommMonoid E] [PartialOrder E] [IsOrderedAddMonoid E] [Module 𝕜 E] [PosSMulMono 𝕜 E]
458   {x y : E}
459 
460 theorem segment_subset_Icc (h : x ≤ y) : [x -[𝕜] y] ⊆ Icc x y := by
461   rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
462   constructor
463   · calc
464       x = a • x + b • x := (Convex.combo_self hab _).symm
465       _ ≤ a • x + b • y := by gcongr
466   · calc
467       a • x + b • y ≤ a • y + b • y := by gcongr
468       _ = y := Convex.combo_self hab _
469 
470 end OrderedAddCommMonoid
471 
472 section OrderedCancelAddCommMonoid
473 
474 variable [AddCommMonoid E] [PartialOrder E] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid E]
475   [Module 𝕜 E] [PosSMulStrictMono 𝕜 E] {x y : E}
476 
477 theorem openSegment_subset_Ioo (h : x < y) : openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ Ioo x y := by
478   rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
479   constructor
480   · calc
481       x = a • x + b • x := (Convex.combo_self hab _).symm
482       _ < a • x + b • y := by gcongr
483   · calc
484       a • x + b • y < a • y + b • y := by gcongr
485       _ = y := Convex.combo_self hab _
486 
487 end OrderedCancelAddCommMonoid
488 
489 section LinearOrderedAddCommMonoid
490 
491 variable [AddCommMonoid E] [LinearOrder E] [IsOrderedAddMonoid E] [Module 𝕜 E] [PosSMulMono 𝕜 E]
492   {a b : 𝕜}
493 
494 theorem segment_subset_uIcc (x y : E) : [x -[𝕜] y] ⊆ uIcc x y := by
495   rcases le_total x y with h | h
496   · rw [uIcc_of_le h]
497     exact segment_subset_Icc h
498   · rw [uIcc_of_ge h, segment_symm]
499     exact segment_subset_Icc h
500 
501 theorem Convex.min_le_combo (x y : E) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
502     min x y ≤ a • x + b • y :=
503   (segment_subset_uIcc x y ⟨_, _, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩).1
504 
505 theorem Convex.combo_le_max (x y : E) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
506     a • x + b • y ≤ max x y :=
507   (segment_subset_uIcc x y ⟨_, _, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩).2
508 
509 end LinearOrderedAddCommMonoid
510 
511 end OrderedSemiring
512 
513 section LinearOrderedField
514 
515 variable [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] {x y z : 𝕜}
516 
517 theorem Icc_subset_segment : Icc x y ⊆ [x -[𝕜] y] := by
518   rintro z ⟨hxz, hyz⟩
519   obtain rfl | h := (hxz.trans hyz).eq_or_lt
520   · rw [segment_same]
521     exact hyz.antisymm hxz
522   rw [← sub_nonneg] at hxz hyz
523   rw [← sub_pos] at h
524   refine ⟨(y - z) / (y - x), (z - x) / (y - x), div_nonneg hyz h.le, div_nonneg hxz h.le, ?_, ?_⟩
525   · rw [← add_div, sub_add_sub_cancel, div_self h.ne']
526   · rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_div_right_comm, ← mul_div_right_comm, ← add_div,
527       div_eq_iff h.ne', add_comm, sub_mul, sub_mul, mul_comm x, sub_add_sub_cancel, mul_sub]
528 
529 @[simp]
530 theorem segment_eq_Icc (h : x ≤ y) : [x -[𝕜] y] = Icc x y :=
531   (segment_subset_Icc h).antisymm Icc_subset_segment
532 
533 theorem Ioo_subset_openSegment : Ioo x y ⊆ openSegment 𝕜 x y := fun _ hz =>
534   mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right hz.1.ne hz.2.ne' <| Icc_subset_segment <| Ioo_subset_Icc_self hz
535 
536 @[simp]
537 theorem openSegment_eq_Ioo (h : x < y) : openSegment 𝕜 x y = Ioo x y :=
538   (openSegment_subset_Ioo h).antisymm Ioo_subset_openSegment
539 
540 theorem segment_eq_Icc' (x y : 𝕜) : [x -[𝕜] y] = Icc (min x y) (max x y) := by
541   rcases le_total x y with h | h
542   · rw [segment_eq_Icc h, max_eq_right h, min_eq_left h]
543   · rw [segment_symm, segment_eq_Icc h, max_eq_left h, min_eq_right h]
544 
545 theorem openSegment_eq_Ioo' (hxy : x ≠ y) : openSegment 𝕜 x y = Ioo (min x y) (max x y) := by
546   rcases hxy.lt_or_gt with h | h
547   · rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo h, max_eq_right h.le, min_eq_left h.le]
548   · rw [openSegment_symm, openSegment_eq_Ioo h, max_eq_left h.le, min_eq_right h.le]
549 
550 theorem segment_eq_uIcc (x y : 𝕜) : [x -[𝕜] y] = uIcc x y :=
551   segment_eq_Icc' _ _
552 
553 /-- A point is in an `Icc` iff it can be expressed as a convex combination of the endpoints. -/
554 theorem Convex.mem_Icc (h : x ≤ y) :
555     z ∈ Icc x y ↔ ∃ a b, 0 ≤ a ∧ 0 ≤ b ∧ a + b = 1 ∧ a * x + b * y = z := by
556   simp only [← segment_eq_Icc h, segment, mem_setOf_eq, smul_eq_mul, exists_and_left]
557 
558 /-- A point is in an `Ioo` iff it can be expressed as a strict convex combination of the endpoints.
559 -/
560 theorem Convex.mem_Ioo (h : x < y) :
561     z ∈ Ioo x y ↔ ∃ a b, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ a + b = 1 ∧ a * x + b * y = z := by
562   simp only [← openSegment_eq_Ioo h, openSegment, smul_eq_mul, exists_and_left, mem_setOf_eq]
563 
564 /-- A point is in an `Ioc` iff it can be expressed as a semistrict convex combination of the
565 endpoints. -/
566 theorem Convex.mem_Ioc (h : x < y) :
567     z ∈ Ioc x y ↔ ∃ a b, 0 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ a + b = 1 ∧ a * x + b * y = z := by
568   refine ⟨fun hz => ?_, ?_⟩
569   · obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩ := (Convex.mem_Icc h.le).1 (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hz)
570     obtain rfl | hb' := hb.eq_or_lt
571     · rw [add_zero] at hab
572       rw [hab, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero] at hz
573       exact (hz.1.ne rfl).elim
574     · exact ⟨a, b, ha, hb', hab, rfl⟩
575   · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
576     obtain rfl | ha' := ha.eq_or_lt
577     · rw [zero_add] at hab
578       rwa [hab, one_mul, zero_mul, zero_add, right_mem_Ioc]
579     · exact Ioo_subset_Ioc_self ((Convex.mem_Ioo h).2 ⟨a, b, ha', hb, hab, rfl⟩)
580 
581 /-- A point is in an `Ico` iff it can be expressed as a semistrict convex combination of the
582 endpoints. -/
583 theorem Convex.mem_Ico (h : x < y) :
584     z ∈ Ico x y ↔ ∃ a b, 0 < a ∧ 0 ≤ b ∧ a + b = 1 ∧ a * x + b * y = z := by
585   refine ⟨fun hz => ?_, ?_⟩
586   · obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩ := (Convex.mem_Icc h.le).1 (Ico_subset_Icc_self hz)
587     obtain rfl | ha' := ha.eq_or_lt
588     · rw [zero_add] at hab
589       rw [hab, one_mul, zero_mul, zero_add] at hz
590       exact (hz.2.ne rfl).elim
591     · exact ⟨a, b, ha', hb, hab, rfl⟩
592   · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
593     obtain rfl | hb' := hb.eq_or_lt
594     · rw [add_zero] at hab
595       rwa [hab, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero, left_mem_Ico]
596     · exact Ioo_subset_Ico_self ((Convex.mem_Ioo h).2 ⟨a, b, ha, hb', hab, rfl⟩)
597 
598 end LinearOrderedField
599 
600 namespace Nonneg
601 
602 variable [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] {x y z : 𝕜}
603 
604 protected lemma Icc_subset_segment {x y : {t : 𝕜 // 0 ≤ t}} :
605     Icc x y ⊆ segment {t : 𝕜 // 0 ≤ t} x y := by
606   intro a ⟨hxa, hay⟩
607   rw [← Subtype.coe_le_coe] at hxa hay
608   rcases Icc_subset_segment ⟨hxa, hay⟩ with ⟨t₁, t₂, t₁_nonneg, t₂_nonneg, t_add, hta⟩
609   refine ⟨⟨t₁, t₁_nonneg⟩, ⟨t₂, t₂_nonneg⟩, zero_le _, zero_le _, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
610   ext <;> simpa
611 
612 protected lemma segment_eq_Icc {x y : {t : 𝕜 // 0 ≤ t}} (hxy : x ≤ y) :
613     segment {t : 𝕜 // 0 ≤ t} x y = Icc x y := by
614   refine subset_antisymm (segment_subset_Icc hxy) Nonneg.Icc_subset_segment
615 
616 protected lemma segment_eq_uIcc {x y : {t : 𝕜 // 0 ≤ t}} :
617     segment {t : 𝕜 // 0 ≤ t} x y = uIcc x y := by
618   rcases le_total x y with h | h
619   · simp [h, Nonneg.segment_eq_Icc]
620   · simp [h, segment_symm _ x y, Nonneg.segment_eq_Icc]
621 
622 end Nonneg
623 
624 namespace Prod
625 
626 variable [Semiring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [AddCommMonoid F] [Module 𝕜 E] [Module 𝕜 F]
627 
628 theorem segment_subset (x y : E × F) : segment 𝕜 x y ⊆ segment 𝕜 x.1 y.1 ×ˢ segment 𝕜 x.2 y.2 := by
629   rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩
630   exact ⟨⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, congr_arg Prod.fst hz⟩, a, b, ha, hb, hab, congr_arg Prod.snd hz⟩
631 
632 theorem openSegment_subset (x y : E × F) :
633     openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ openSegment 𝕜 x.1 y.1 ×ˢ openSegment 𝕜 x.2 y.2 := by
634   rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩
635   exact ⟨⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, congr_arg Prod.fst hz⟩, a, b, ha, hb, hab, congr_arg Prod.snd hz⟩
636 
637 theorem image_mk_segment_left (x₁ x₂ : E) (y : F) :
638     (fun x => (x, y)) '' [x₁ -[𝕜] x₂] = [(x₁, y) -[𝕜] (x₂, y)] := by
639   rw [segment_eq_image₂, segment_eq_image₂, image_image]
640   refine EqOn.image_eq fun a ha ↦ ?_
641   simp [Convex.combo_self ha.2.2]
642 
643 theorem image_mk_segment_right (x : E) (y₁ y₂ : F) :
644     (fun y => (x, y)) '' [y₁ -[𝕜] y₂] = [(x, y₁) -[𝕜] (x, y₂)] := by
645   rw [segment_eq_image₂, segment_eq_image₂, image_image]
646   refine EqOn.image_eq fun a ha ↦ ?_
647   simp [Convex.combo_self ha.2.2]
648 
649 theorem image_mk_openSegment_left (x₁ x₂ : E) (y : F) :
650     (fun x => (x, y)) '' openSegment 𝕜 x₁ x₂ = openSegment 𝕜 (x₁, y) (x₂, y) := by
651   rw [openSegment_eq_image₂, openSegment_eq_image₂, image_image]
652   refine EqOn.image_eq fun a ha ↦ ?_
653   simp [Convex.combo_self ha.2.2]
654 
655 @[simp]
656 theorem image_mk_openSegment_right (x : E) (y₁ y₂ : F) :
657     (fun y => (x, y)) '' openSegment 𝕜 y₁ y₂ = openSegment 𝕜 (x, y₁) (x, y₂) := by
658   rw [openSegment_eq_image₂, openSegment_eq_image₂, image_image]
659   refine EqOn.image_eq fun a ha ↦ ?_
660   simp [Convex.combo_self ha.2.2]
661 
662 end Prod
663 
664 namespace Pi
665 
666 variable [Semiring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M i)] [∀ i, Module 𝕜 (M i)] {s : Set ι}
667 
668 theorem segment_subset (x y : ∀ i, M i) : segment 𝕜 x y ⊆ s.pi fun i => segment 𝕜 (x i) (y i) := by
669   rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩ i -
670   exact ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, congr_fun hz i⟩
671 
672 theorem openSegment_subset (x y : ∀ i, M i) :
673     openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ s.pi fun i => openSegment 𝕜 (x i) (y i) := by
674   rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩ i -
675   exact ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, congr_fun hz i⟩
676 
677 variable [DecidableEq ι]
678 
679 theorem image_update_segment (i : ι) (x₁ x₂ : M i) (y : ∀ i, M i) :
680     update y i '' [x₁ -[𝕜] x₂] = [update y i x₁ -[𝕜] update y i x₂] := by
681   rw [segment_eq_image₂, segment_eq_image₂, image_image]
682   refine EqOn.image_eq fun a ha ↦ ?_
683   simp only [← update_smul, ← update_add, Convex.combo_self ha.2.2]
684 
685 theorem image_update_openSegment (i : ι) (x₁ x₂ : M i) (y : ∀ i, M i) :
686     update y i '' openSegment 𝕜 x₁ x₂ = openSegment 𝕜 (update y i x₁) (update y i x₂) := by
687   rw [openSegment_eq_image₂, openSegment_eq_image₂, image_image]
688   refine EqOn.image_eq fun a ha ↦ ?_
689   simp only [← update_smul, ← update_add, Convex.combo_self ha.2.2]
690 
691 end Pi
